name: Pineapple Distress
author: TehEmperor
description: A game made for CWC Game Jam. The Topic is "Modernizing the Classics" and this is our take on "Frogger". You Play as a Chief who is trying to get pineapples for his pizza. Made by a team of three semi-porffesionals. (Sean Silla, Andrew McLane, Leonid Yerukhimov).
